### 核心实现逻辑差异（相比 R1G）

1. **`Get-InventoryAction` 分类策略**：
   ```powershell
   function Get-InventoryAction([object]$GitMode, [bool]$IsReparsePoint, [bool]$IsLeaf, [bool]$IsContainer) {
       if ($IsLeaf -and $GitMode -eq '120000' -and $IsReparsePoint) { return 'SKIP_TRACKED_SYMLINK' }
       if ($IsLeaf -and $GitMode -eq '120000' -and -not $IsReparsePoint -and -not $IsContainer) { return 'SKIP_GIT_SYMLINK_NONREPARSE' }
       if ($IsReparsePoint -or ($IsLeaf -and ($GitMode -eq '120000' -or $IsContainer))) { return 'STOP' }
       if ($IsLeaf -and $null -ne $GitMode -and $GitMode -notin @('100644', '100755')) { return 'STOP' }
       return 'HASH_REGULAR_FILE'
   }
   ```
2. **`Get-RepositoryRecord` no-follow 处理与 fail-closed 保证**：
   ```powershell
   if ($action -eq 'SKIP_GIT_SYMLINK_NONREPARSE') {
       if (-not $record.targetMatches -or $record.commands.status.exitCode -ne 0) {
           throw "Git baseline mismatch before non-reparse symlink skip: $relative"
       }
       $record.linkInventory.Add([ordered]@{ path = $relative; mode = $gitMode; state = 'SKIPPED_GIT_SYMLINK_NONREPARSE'; attributes = [string]$item.Attributes; linkType = (Get-LinkTypeEvidence $item); targetRead = 'NOT_ATTEMPTED'; targetHash = 'NOT_CAPTURED' })
       $record.skippedSymlinkCount++
       $record.processedCount++
       $linkSkipped = $true
       # A skipped symlink must not receive any further path, target, hash, or ACL query.
       break
   }
   ```
   随后通过 `if ($linkSkipped) { continue }` 直接跳过后续文件内容哈希。
